primitives.name: Quadratic Form Test Statistic
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method / model Test statistic (8): T = Σ_{i,j} I_ij [k^q(k^q-1)(X2-X) + k^p(k^p-1)(Y2-Y) - 2(k^p-1)(k^q-1)XY] / [(k^p-1)(k^q-1)(k^p+k^q)] — an unbiased-for-zero-under-null quadratic form; reject when T ≥ 11d (general threshold d√(24(2-ν)/ν) for error ν).

Rank-breaking allows extension to full or partial rankings by decomposing them into comparable pairwise structures. These primitives together enable a principled, model-free approach to detecting shifts in team strength or performance regimes across time windows.
